text:
anya: Quick heads-up — we want to swap runtime to quant-kernel-v3 during the early-morning quiet window tomorrow (02:00-03:00 PT) as part of the sprint cut. Need: canary slice size, rollback criteria, who’s oncall, and a short release-note blurb.

maya: +1. main risk is thermal tail on older nvgpus — i'm thinking staged slices across regions rather than full traffic. suggest 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 30m intervals.

leo: Agree on staged ramp. Also can we pin legacy engine as a fast fallback for the first hour? Keeps evictions low.

sam: I can be oncall for the cutover. Rollback trigger: if p95 token-latency increases > 10% vs baseline for 3 consecutive 5-min windows OR error rate > 0.5%. If either hits, we abort and pin-back.

maya: Sounds good. Add perf-regression guard on cold path too (first-token p99).

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECKS STARTED for quant-kernel-v3
- binary-signature: ok
- model-compat: ok
- smoke-tests: running
- kv-cache-smoke: running

ci-bot: smoke-tests: 14/15 passed, one flaky test (embedding/consistency) — infra says non-blocking. Full logs: https://ci.internal/reports/581234/smoke (shared)

anya: Given smoke flake, i want tighter canary (1% initial). If green for 20m -> 5% for 20m -> 25%. If any spike, immediate pin-back.

leo: Pin TTL? set to 60m so ops can route back while we triage.

sam: I'll watch dashboards and set a quiet alert: deployment-channel notify if p95 delta > 6% or errors > 0.3% (more sensitive during first hour).

maya: Deploy command i'll run:
```
deploybot deploy --engine quant-kernel-v3 --canary 1% --lift 20m --regions us-west-2,us-east-1
```

anya: Release notes blurb (draft): "Engine: quant-kernel-v3 — improved int8 matmul kernel with better throughput and lower memory for long contexts. Rolling canary to minimize risk. See changelog for benchmarks."

leo: also add ops note: "If fallback required, pin-back to engine-2026-02-18 and notify eng-runtime oncall."

deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT COMPLETE — status: OK (smoke non-blocking). Scheduling window reserved: 02:00-03:00 PT. ETA start: 02:05 PT.

maya: I'll kick off at 02:05 and stick around for first 45m. Sam will own alerts & rollback. Leo you have pin authority.

sam: Got it. i'll create an incident channel and set the alerting thresholds now.

anya: Thanks — i'll post the release-note blurb to release-notes later today. tagging @sam @leo @maya for final ack. :thumbsup:

maya: ack

sam: ack

leo: ack
